kilns:Brick kiln:21.676,89.2319.name: Brick kiln
kilns:Brick kiln:21.676,89.2319.desc: The position is the tile’s own reference point — the dataset records kilns as annotated boxes inside a satellite tile rather than as individual coordinates, so this locates them to within about a kilometre, not to a chimney. Detected from Sentinel-2 satellite imagery and hand-validated, from SentinelKilnDB — 62,671 kilns across the Indo-Gangetic Plain covering India, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Afghanistan.
